title: Photo Gallery of Mesopotamia

Photo Gallery

    of

    Ancient Mesopotamia and Persia

By

    K. C. Hanson 

    Many of the photographs included here were taken at European museums
in  June, 1997.  By *CLICKING* on the photo you will be linked to a larger
image  along with a more detailed description of the object.  I hope eventually
to include ancient quotations to go along with each of the objects.
